saw_lines: Game day shoppers buy for a crowd and want the whole spread in one trip, at a price they can check.
So the sale is won or lost in the ad, before any click, on whether price and arrival are visible.
Your 30 ads never mention price, yet the homepage shows prices. Open one ad with the price per pound, then test three variations of that.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 6 Nov 2026
points: Your 30 ads never mention price, yet the homepage shows prices. Without a price, shoppers cannot tell if the food is a bargain. Open one ad with the price per pound, then test three variations of that.

Your site explains how orders arrive, yet 0 of 30 ads say so. Buyers wondering if a tailgate order reaches them in time will skip the ad. Shoot one video of an order arriving and open the next batch with it.

None of your 30 ads carries a proof number, so a new shopper has nothing concrete to trust. Collect one real figure, such as orders shipped or entries received, and print it on the creative of your oldest ads.
0 of 30 ads carry an offer, so new buyers have no reason to act today. Pair the food, snacks and drinks into one bundle at a set price. Lead three new ads with that bundle or a first order offer.
